title: Diagnostic Report: Promart (Intercorp Group)
summary: Promart.pe runs on VTEX Legacy Portal with approximately 6.8M monthly visits and a massive product catalog spanning 327 product sitemaps. The site has significant opportunities in structured data (no Product JSON-LD detected), mobile performance (Lighthouse score 30/100, LCP 12.7s), and content engine scaling (only 10 blog posts for a catalog of this size).
